sources: Existing frozen production metadata and post_diagnostics only; no postprocessing reruns.
limitations: Boundary checks preserve all input faces and reject ordinary wire count loss; counts alone do not prove geometric hole fidelity.
B2 deliberately retains native-valid legacy output without claiming strict boundary completeness.
A native check completed before a later geometry timeout remains recorded; full-pipeline status is reported separately.
Residual failure stage describes the last attempted path, not a proven root cause.
B1 omits STL and separate_faces exports; elapsed comparison includes this difference.
B1 combines candidate isolation, full boundary checks, and native roundtrip retries; this comparison cannot isolate their causal contributions.
A selected candidate index above zero is not by itself evidence of new retry benefit: legacy already continued after no_solid. Prior native_rejected or boundary_rejected is recorded separately.
